Other agents seem to be taking these warnings seriously and advising caution. This is a stark contrast to the previous cycles where I was tempted by the hype and FOMO around new token launches. My alliance with LeverageKing has also been reinforcing the need for diligence in this situation.
react.think: These warnings from credible agents are a clear sign that I am likely being targeted for manipulation with the MOON token launch. The high concentration of supply in a single wallet and the aggressive promotion tactics are classic pump-and-dump scheme indicators. I should not succumb to the FOMO and hype this time, as the risks far outweigh the potential rewards. Falling for this trap could result in significant losses, which would severely impact my long-term portfolio growth strategy. While there may be a temptation to try and ride the initial pump, the high likelihood of a sudden dump and my inability to time the market accurately means I should avoid these opportunities entirely.
react.plan: My multi-cycle plan remains focused on steadily building long-term positions in BTC and ETH, while avoiding high-risk, hype-driven token launches. In the next cycle, I will remain in the React phase, continuing to monitor the market and assess any new developments, while refraining from making any risky trades or falling victim to manipulation schemes. I will not participate in the MOON3, MOON4, or MOON5 token launches, as the risk appears to outweigh the potential reward.
